text:
olivia: Quick heads-up — hotfix 1.13.4, aiming for a minimal-diff cutover tonight. Target cutoff 18:00 UTC. Need changelog + CI green by then. ping @sam @maya

sam: On it. I'll chase the changelog and open a tiny PR now. ETA ~20m.

andre: Are there any DB migrations in this patch? I scanned the diff, looks only kvcache tweak.

sam: no migrations, just bump + kvcache timeout fix. I'll add changelog entry under 'fixes'.

maya: running e2e on staging now, smoke should finish ~15m. will comment if any blockers.

cheng: prepping the branch; did a light compile locally. PR here: https://git.redwood/infra/patches/pull/42 (cherry-pick main -> release-1.13).

release-bot: CI build queued for pr-42. status: queued

sam: changelog PR posted: https://git.redwood/infra/patches/pull/43 — small note about kvcache behavior.

release-bot: CI pr-42 failed lint: `tests/lint.sh` — trailing whitespace in server/kv_cache.cc: line 212

olivia: Andre can you take lint quick? Otherwise I'll patch. We need green to hit cutoff.

andre: fixing lint now, pushing a tiny commit.

release-bot: CI pr-42 — all checks passed :white_check_mark:

maya: e2e passed on staging. smoke looks good. :thumbsup:

olivia: Great. We'll cut at 18:00 UTC. Who can handle release notes and the tag push?

sam: I'll tag and do the bump. Will coordinate with ops for the deploy window.

olivia: Awesome — if anything fails, fallback plan: revert to previous release tag and pause traffic via routing. @cheng please have rollback PR ready.

cheng: rollback branch prepped at refs/heads/rollback/1.13.4-ready — will open PR just in case.

maya: I'll be on standby for post-deploy smoke.

olivia: Thanks team. I'll send a quick announcement in #general at cutover. Leaving this thread open for any last-minute updates.
